decisive_spans.text: A recent trial of oral terbinafine yielded no improvement
4-mm punch biopsy from right arm showed superficial and deep perivascular and interstitial inflammation with numerous eosinophils
Hematoxylin and eosin stain demonstrating numerous scattered eosinophils

response.rationale: D3 is strongly supported by the presence of eosinophils on biopsy and the failure of antifungal treatment, suggesting a drug-induced etiology. D2 is also supported by the eosinophil findings but lacks the specific link to drug-induced etiology that D3 has. The other candidates are less supported or contradicted.
